title: CRC Machzor (2008)
source: shireishabbat research/current-siddurim/Machzor-2008.pdf (221-page scan; printed folios 1-215, PDF offset -6). SERVICE-SCOPED (R4-c, reversed by Daniel 2026-09-15): all 209 entries are generated by scripts/emit-machzor-book.mjs from the six per-service feeds in shireishabbat dist-app/ @d86de56-LICENSED (crc-erev-rh 1-37, crc-rh-morning 38-92, crc-kol-nidre 93-127, crc-yk-morning 128-178, crc-yizkor 179-185, crc-neilah 187-215); every page is a capture's own printedFolio, none typed by hand. 49 prayer names repeat across the six services - Bar'chu prints at 9, 45, 100 and 136 - so each entry carries its `service` and a lookup narrows to the setlist's templateType before ranking. source: shireishabbat dist-app/shabbat-shacharit-feed.json @8cc8d9a+dirty (ALPHA DRAFT, not a printed volume; folios never published - Ruling 8, 2026-09-15). pages = last FOLIO number, measured as physical pages minus this book's constant folio offset of 7: the feed records printing.pages 151 and its pageIndex runs folios 2..143, so 151-7 = 144. RE-RECORDED from 146 (2026-09-15, R2-b). 146 was correct and measured, for a different build: dist/ @8ab7be6 was 153 physical pages at the same offset. The number is build-dependent precisely because this book has never been printed - there is no press commit to pin it to, which is why R2-b dropped the pin. Re-record whenever dist-app is rebuilt, from printing.pages minus 7.
